hook.name: GuUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Singleton hook for GuCoin/reserve-token pools that computes dynamic swap fees using a volatility oracle (Algebra adaptive fee) and directional sliding fee factors. Collects fees via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and distributes them to protocol and LP fee receivers. Swaps are gated by a per-pool security registry and a GuCoin LP status flag.
